merge_policy: Research staging only. Exact-scan names/aliases against condition_canon_shortlist.json; fill empty fields only; repo schema/DECISIONS and validator output win.

conditions.overview_en: Peptic ulcer disease is ulceration of the stomach or duodenal mucosa and can be complicated by bleeding, perforation, penetration, or gastric/duodenal obstruction.
conditions.overview_zh: 消化性潰瘍是胃或十二指腸黏膜形成潰瘍，可併發出血、穿孔、穿透或胃／十二指腸阻塞。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: The dominant mechanisms are mucosal injury related to Helicobacter pylori infection and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug exposure, with acid-peptic injury exceeding mucosal defenses.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 主要機轉為幽門螺旋桿菌感染或非類固醇抗發炎藥造成黏膜防禦受損，使酸與胃蛋白酶相關損傷超過黏膜保護能力。
diagnostic_signs_en: Epigastric pain or discomfort
Early satiety or post-meal fullness
Nausea, bloating, or belching
GI bleeding may present with hematemesis, melena, anemia, or hemodynamic instability
diagnostic_signs_zh: 上腹痛或不適
早飽或餐後飽脹
噁心、腹脹或打嗝
消化道出血可表現為吐血、黑便、貧血或血流動力學不穩定
diagnostic_tests_en: Assess medication history, especially NSAIDs, and H. pylori history
H. pylori testing with urea breath or stool testing when appropriate
Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy when indicated
CBC and other tests when bleeding or complications are suspected
diagnostic_tests_zh: 評估用藥史，尤其 NSAIDs，並詢問幽門螺旋桿菌病史
適當時以尿素呼氣或糞便檢測幽門螺旋桿菌
有適應症時做上消化道內視鏡與活檢
懷疑出血或併發症時評估 CBC 等檢驗
treatment_principles_en: Promote ulcer healing with acid suppression, commonly a PPI
Identify and eradicate H. pylori when present
Stop, reduce, or modify ulcerogenic NSAID exposure when clinically feasible
Urgently manage bleeding, perforation, obstruction, or other complications
treatment_principles_zh: 以抑酸治療促進潰瘍癒合，常使用 PPI
確認並根除幽門螺旋桿菌感染
臨床可行時停用、減量或調整致潰瘍 NSAID
出血、穿孔、阻塞等併發症需緊急處理
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子，不建立「消化性潰瘍＝某一中醫病名／證型」的等同關係。臨床可依胃脘痛、嘈雜、反酸、黑便等實際表現，再鑑別肝胃不和、脾胃虛弱、瘀血阻絡等候選機轉。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only; do not equate peptic ulcer disease with one TCM disease or pattern. Actual findings such as epigastric pain, reflux-like symptoms, or bleeding should drive differential candidates such as Liver-Stomach disharmony, Spleen-Stomach deficiency, or blood stasis.

key_references.title: Peptic Ulcers – Definition, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment

conditions.overview_en: Gallstones are hardened material in the gallbladder or biliary system. They may be asymptomatic or cause biliary pain and complications when stones obstruct ducts.
conditions.overview_zh: 膽結石是膽囊或膽道內形成的硬化物質，可無症狀，也可因結石阻塞膽道而造成膽絞痛與併發症。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Stones form when bile composition and gallbladder function favor precipitation of cholesterol or pigment material. Obstruction can provoke biliary colic, cholecystitis, cholangitis, or pancreatitis.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 當膽汁成分與膽囊功能促使膽固醇或色素物質析出時可形成結石；若造成膽道阻塞，可引起膽絞痛、膽囊炎、膽管炎或胰臟炎。
diagnostic_signs_en: Episodes of upper abdominal or right upper quadrant pain, often after meals
Nausea or vomiting may occur
Fever, jaundice, or persistent severe pain suggests a complication rather than uncomplicated biliary colic
diagnostic_signs_zh: 上腹或右上腹陣發性疼痛，常與進食相關
可伴噁心或嘔吐
發燒、黃疸或持續劇烈疼痛提示可能已有併發症，而非單純膽絞痛
diagnostic_tests_en: Abdominal ultrasound is the preferred imaging test for gallstones
Blood tests can identify inflammation, infection, or hepatobiliary/pancreatic involvement
MR-based or endoscopic biliary imaging may be used when ductal stones are suspected
ERCP is used selectively and can also treat common bile duct stones
diagnostic_tests_zh: 腹部超音波是尋找膽結石的首選影像檢查
血液檢查可評估發炎、感染與肝膽／胰臟受累
懷疑膽管結石時可使用磁振或內視鏡膽道影像
ERCP 選擇性使用，亦可處理總膽管結石
treatment_principles_en: Asymptomatic stones often require no treatment
Symptomatic gallstones are commonly treated with cholecystectomy
Treat ductal obstruction and complications promptly; ERCP may be used for common bile duct stones
Selected cholesterol stones may have nonsurgical options, but these are not the usual approach
treatment_principles_zh: 無症狀膽結石通常不需治療
有症狀膽結石常以膽囊切除術處理
膽道阻塞與併發症需及時處置；總膽管結石可使用 ERCP
特定膽固醇結石可有非手術選項，但並非常規首選
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。可依脅痛、黃疸、噁心等實際表現鑑別肝膽氣滯、濕熱、痰濁或瘀阻等候選機轉，不把膽結石直接等同於單一中醫病名或證型。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. Findings such as hypochondriac pain, jaundice, and nausea may support candidate mechanisms involving Liver-Gallbladder qi constraint, damp-heat, phlegm, or stasis; no one-to-one equivalence is asserted.

conditions.overview_en: Diverticulosis is the presence of colonic pouches; diverticular disease refers to symptoms, bleeding, inflammation, or complications related to those pouches. Diverticulitis is inflammation involving diverticula.
conditions.overview_zh: 憩室症是結腸壁形成囊狀突出；當憩室造成症狀、出血、發炎或其他併發症時屬憩室病，其中憩室炎指憩室相關發炎。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Diverticula form through weak points in the colonic wall. Symptoms and complications arise when diverticula bleed, become inflamed, perforate, form abscesses or fistulas, or contribute to obstruction.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 憩室由結腸壁薄弱處向外突出形成；當憩室出血、發炎、穿孔、形成膿瘍或瘻管，或造成阻塞時便產生臨床症狀與併發症。
diagnostic_signs_en: Lower abdominal pain or cramping
Constipation, diarrhea, or bloating may occur
Diverticulitis often causes more severe focal abdominal pain
Rectal bleeding, fever, peritoneal signs, or systemic illness increases concern for complications
diagnostic_signs_zh: 下腹痛或絞痛
可有便祕、腹瀉或腹脹
憩室炎常出現較明顯的局部腹痛
直腸出血、發燒、腹膜刺激徵或全身性不適提示併發症風險
diagnostic_tests_en: History and abdominal examination
Blood and stool tests as indicated
CT, ultrasound, or MRI depending on presentation
Colonoscopy may be used after acute issues are addressed to confirm disease or exclude other conditions; it can also treat diverticular bleeding
diagnostic_tests_zh: 病史與腹部理學檢查
視情況安排血液與糞便檢查
依臨床表現使用 CT、超音波或 MRI
急性問題處理後可用大腸鏡確認病變或排除其他疾病；亦可處理憩室出血
treatment_principles_en: Tailor treatment to chronic symptomatic disease versus acute diverticulitis versus complications
Uncomplicated diverticulitis may be managed conservatively in selected patients; antibiotics are not required for every patient
Hospital care, drainage, endoscopic hemostasis, or surgery may be needed for severe disease or complications
Long-term risk reduction may include adequate fiber and other lifestyle measures when appropriate
treatment_principles_zh: 依慢性症狀、急性憩室炎或併發症分層治療
部分單純性憩室炎可保守處理，並非每位患者都必須使用抗生素
重症或併發症可能需要住院、引流、內視鏡止血或手術
長期可依個別情況採取足量纖維與其他生活型態措施降低風險
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。依腹痛、便祕、腹瀉、腹脹或出血等實際表現，可再鑑別腸腑氣滯、濕熱、瘀血或脾虛等候選機轉；不把憩室病當作單一中醫證型。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. Abdominal pain, bowel-pattern change, distension, or bleeding may support several TCM mechanisms such as qi stagnation, damp-heat, blood stasis, or Spleen deficiency; no one-to-one mapping is asserted.

conditions.overview_en: Celiac disease is an immune-mediated disorder triggered by dietary gluten in genetically susceptible people and can damage the small-intestinal mucosa, causing gastrointestinal and extraintestinal manifestations.
conditions.overview_zh: 乳糜瀉是在遺傳易感族群中由飲食麩質觸發的免疫介導疾病，可損傷小腸黏膜，產生腸胃道及腸外表現。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Gluten exposure triggers an abnormal immune response that injures the small intestinal mucosa, leading to villous injury, malabsorption, nutrient deficiencies, and systemic manifestations.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 麩質暴露引發異常免疫反應並損傷小腸黏膜，可造成絨毛損傷、吸收不良、營養缺乏與全身性表現。
diagnostic_signs_en: Diarrhea, bloating, abdominal pain, or other GI symptoms
Weight loss or growth problems may occur
Extraintestinal findings may include anemia, bone disease, dermatitis herpetiformis, oral or dental findings, or neurologic symptoms
Symptoms alone are not sufficiently specific for diagnosis
diagnostic_signs_zh: 可見腹瀉、腹脹、腹痛等腸胃症狀
可有體重減輕或生長問題
腸外表現可包括貧血、骨骼問題、疱疹樣皮膚炎、口腔／牙齒或神經症狀
單靠症狀不足以確診
diagnostic_tests_en: Serologic testing, commonly tTG-IgA with assessment of IgA status
Small-intestinal biopsy is commonly used to confirm the diagnosis when indicated
Testing should generally occur while the patient is still consuming gluten
Genetic testing can help exclude or clarify selected cases
diagnostic_tests_zh: 血清學檢測，常以 tTG-IgA 並評估 IgA 狀態
有適應症時以小腸活檢確認診斷
一般應在患者仍攝取麩質時完成診斷檢測
特定情況可使用遺傳檢測協助排除或釐清
treatment_principles_en: Lifelong strict gluten-free diet
Dietitian support to identify hidden gluten and maintain nutritional adequacy
Assess and correct nutritional deficiencies and monitor recovery
Re-evaluate persistent symptoms for ongoing gluten exposure, alternate diagnoses, or refractory disease
treatment_principles_zh: 終身嚴格無麩質飲食
由營養師協助辨識隱藏麩質並維持營養完整
評估與矯正營養缺乏並追蹤恢復
症狀持續時重新評估持續麩質暴露、其他診斷或難治型疾病
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。長期腹瀉、腹脹、乏力與吸收不良可依個別表現鑑別脾氣虛、脾陽虛、濕困等候選機轉；不可把乳糜瀉本身等同於「脾虛」。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. Chronic diarrhea, distension, fatigue, and malabsorption may support candidate mechanisms such as Spleen qi/yang deficiency or dampness, but celiac disease itself is not equivalent to any one TCM pattern.

key_references.title: Celiac Disease Tests for Health Care Professionals

conditions.overview_en: Lactose intolerance is the occurrence of digestive symptoms after lactose ingestion due to lactose malabsorption; lactose malabsorption alone does not equal symptomatic lactose intolerance.
conditions.overview_zh: 乳糖不耐是因乳糖吸收不良，在攝取乳糖後出現消化症狀；只有乳糖吸收不良而沒有症狀，不等同於乳糖不耐。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Low intestinal lactase activity leaves lactose incompletely digested. Unabsorbed lactose is fermented by colonic bacteria and draws water into the bowel, producing gas, bloating, pain, and diarrhea.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 小腸乳糖酶活性不足使乳糖無法完全消化；未吸收的乳糖進入結腸後被細菌發酵並增加腸腔滲透負荷，因此產生脹氣、腹痛與腹瀉。
diagnostic_signs_en: Bloating, diarrhea, gas, nausea, abdominal pain, or borborygmi after lactose exposure
Symptoms vary with lactose dose and individual tolerance
Distinguish from cow's-milk protein allergy and other GI disorders
diagnostic_signs_zh: 攝取乳糖後出現腹脹、腹瀉、排氣、噁心、腹痛或腸鳴
症狀程度依乳糖量與個人耐受度而異
需與牛奶蛋白過敏及其他腸胃疾病鑑別
diagnostic_tests_en: Clinical history linking symptoms to lactose exposure
Trial of lactose reduction may support the assessment
Hydrogen breath testing may be used when confirmation is needed
Evaluate alternative causes when symptoms persist or are atypical
diagnostic_tests_zh: 病史確認症狀與乳糖暴露的時間關係
減少乳糖的飲食試驗可協助評估
需要確認時可使用氫氣呼氣試驗
症狀持續或不典型時需評估其他原因
treatment_principles_en: Individualize lactose restriction rather than assuming complete dairy avoidance
Lactase enzyme products may help some patients
Maintain adequate calcium, vitamin D, and overall nutrition
Treat a reversible underlying small-intestinal disorder when present
treatment_principles_zh: 依個人耐受度調整乳糖攝取，不應一律假設必須完全避免乳製品
乳糖酶產品可幫助部分患者
維持足夠鈣、維生素 D 與整體營養
若有可逆的小腸疾病，應處理原發原因
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。乳製品後腹脹、腹瀉、腸鳴可依舌脈與全身狀態鑑別脾虛、寒濕、濕困或食積等候選機轉，而不是把乳糖不耐固定歸為單一證型。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. Post-dairy distension, diarrhea, and borborygmi may fit several candidate mechanisms such as Spleen deficiency, cold-damp, dampness, or food retention depending on the whole presentation.

key_references.title: Eating, Diet, & Nutrition for Lactose Intolerance

conditions.overview_en: Acute pancreatitis is sudden inflammation of the pancreas that ranges from a self-limited illness to severe systemic disease with local and organ complications.
conditions.overview_zh: 急性胰臟炎是胰臟突然發炎，可從短期自限性疾病到伴隨局部或器官併發症的重症。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Premature activation of pancreatic digestive enzymes and inflammatory pathways causes pancreatic injury and may trigger systemic inflammation. Gallstones and heavy alcohol exposure are common causes, with medications, metabolic factors, and genetic causes also possible.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 胰臟消化酵素過早活化與發炎途徑啟動造成胰臟損傷，嚴重時可引發全身性發炎。膽結石與大量飲酒是常見原因，也可能與藥物、代謝或遺傳因素有關。
diagnostic_signs_en: Acute upper abdominal pain, often radiating to the back
Nausea and vomiting
Abdominal tenderness
Fever or tachycardia may occur; hypotension or organ dysfunction suggests severe disease
diagnostic_signs_zh: 急性上腹痛，常可向背部放射
噁心與嘔吐
腹部壓痛
可見發燒或心搏過速；低血壓或器官功能障礙提示重症
diagnostic_tests_en: Serum lipase and/or amylase
Blood tests for metabolic, inflammatory, hepatic, or biliary clues
Ultrasound, CT, MRI/MRCP, or endoscopic ultrasound depending on cause and severity
Assess for gallstones, alcohol exposure, medications, hypertriglyceridemia, and other etiologies
diagnostic_tests_zh: 血清 lipase 和／或 amylase
血液檢查評估代謝、發炎、肝膽等線索
依病因與嚴重度使用超音波、CT、MRI/MRCP 或內視鏡超音波
評估膽結石、飲酒、藥物、高三酸甘油脂及其他病因
treatment_principles_en: Acute pancreatitis is a medical condition requiring conventional evaluation and supportive care
Provide fluids, analgesia, nutrition, and monitoring as clinically indicated
Treat the cause and complications, including biliary obstruction when present
Escalate care for severe disease, infection, necrosis, organ failure, or other complications
treatment_principles_zh: 急性胰臟炎屬需西醫評估與支持治療的急性疾病
依臨床情況給予補液、止痛、營養與監測
處理病因與併發症，包括膽道阻塞
重症、感染、壞死、器官衰竭或其他併發症需升級處置
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作學習用辨證種子，急性胰臟炎不可由中醫辨證取代急診／住院評估。若作整合醫學研究，可依劇烈腹痛、脹滿、噁心、發熱等分別討論腑氣不通、濕熱、食積、氣滯血瘀等候選機轉。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Study-only differentiation seed. TCM patterning must never replace urgent biomedical evaluation of acute pancreatitis. For integrative research, findings may generate candidates involving obstructed fu-organ qi, damp-heat, food retention, qi stagnation, or blood stasis.

conditions.overview_en: Cirrhosis is advanced hepatic scarring in which scar tissue replaces healthy liver tissue, distorts liver architecture, impairs function, and can progress to portal hypertension and liver failure.
conditions.overview_zh: 肝硬化是進展性肝臟纖維化，疤痕組織取代正常肝組織、扭曲肝臟結構並降低功能，可進一步造成門脈高壓與肝衰竭。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Chronic liver injury causes fibrosis and regenerative nodules, disrupting hepatic blood flow and normal hepatocyte function. Major etiologies include alcohol-associated liver disease, metabolic fatty liver disease, and chronic viral hepatitis.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 慢性肝損傷造成纖維化與再生結節，破壞肝內血流與正常肝細胞功能。常見病因包括酒精相關肝病、代謝性脂肪肝疾病與慢性病毒性肝炎。
diagnostic_signs_en: May be asymptomatic until advanced
Fatigue, pruritus, jaundice, edema, ascites, or muscle wasting
Portal-hypertension findings may include varices or splenomegaly
Confusion or sleep/cognitive change may indicate hepatic encephalopathy
diagnostic_signs_zh: 早期可能沒有症狀
可見疲倦、搔癢、黃疸、水腫、腹水或肌肉流失
門脈高壓可出現靜脈曲張或脾腫大等表現
意識混亂、睡眠或認知改變可能提示肝性腦病
diagnostic_tests_en: Liver biochemical tests, bilirubin, albumin, CBC, coagulation and etiologic laboratory workup
Ultrasound, CT, MRI, and/or elastography
Liver biopsy when diagnosis or cause remains uncertain
Ongoing surveillance for complications according to specialist guidance
diagnostic_tests_zh: 肝功能相關檢驗、膽紅素、白蛋白、CBC、凝血與病因檢查
超音波、CT、MRI 和／或彈性影像
診斷或病因仍不確定時可做肝活檢
依專科建議持續監測併發症
treatment_principles_en: Treat the underlying cause to slow further liver injury
Avoid hepatotoxic exposures and manage nutrition and comorbidities
Prevent and treat complications such as ascites, varices, encephalopathy, infection, and hepatocellular carcinoma
Refer for transplant evaluation when decompensation or liver failure warrants it
treatment_principles_zh: 處理原發病因以減緩進一步肝損傷
避免肝毒性暴露並管理營養與共病
預防與處理腹水、靜脈曲張、肝性腦病、感染與肝細胞癌等併發症
失代償或肝衰竭達適應症時轉介肝移植評估
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。腹脹、腹水、脅痛、黃疸、乏力等可跨越積聚、鼓脹、黃疸等傳統病證範疇，常需從氣滯、濕、水、瘀以及肝脾腎虛損的複合演變辨證，不能以單一證型代替肝硬化診斷。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. Distension, ascites, hypochondriac discomfort, jaundice, and fatigue may span several traditional disease categories and mixed mechanisms involving qi constraint, damp/fluid retention, blood stasis, and Liver-Spleen-Kidney deficiency.

conditions.overview_en: Hepatitis B is infection with hepatitis B virus. Infection may be acute or become chronic; chronic infection can cause progressive liver injury, cirrhosis, and liver cancer.
conditions.overview_zh: B 型肝炎是 B 型肝炎病毒感染，可為急性感染，也可能轉為慢性；慢性感染可造成進行性肝損傷、肝硬化與肝癌。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: HBV infects hepatocytes and liver injury is largely mediated by the host immune response. Persistent viral infection can produce chronic necroinflammation and fibrosis.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: HBV 感染肝細胞後，肝損傷很大部分來自宿主免疫反應；持續病毒感染可造成慢性壞死性發炎與纖維化。
diagnostic_signs_en: Many infections may be asymptomatic
Possible fatigue, anorexia, nausea, abdominal discomfort, dark urine, or jaundice
Chronic disease may first present through abnormal liver tests or complications of cirrhosis
diagnostic_signs_zh: 許多感染者可能沒有症狀
可出現疲倦、食慾下降、噁心、腹部不適、深色尿或黃疸
慢性病可能先因肝功能異常或肝硬化併發症而被發現
diagnostic_tests_en: HBV serologic blood tests to determine infection status
HBV DNA and liver tests to assess viral activity and liver injury when chronic infection is present
Imaging or fibrosis assessment as indicated
Evaluate for cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma risk in chronic disease
diagnostic_tests_zh: 以 HBV 血清學檢查判定感染狀態
慢性感染時以 HBV DNA 與肝臟檢驗評估病毒活性與肝損傷
依情況安排影像或纖維化評估
慢性病需評估肝硬化與肝細胞癌風險
treatment_principles_en: Acute hepatitis B is usually managed supportively unless severe disease requires specialist care
Not every patient with chronic hepatitis B requires antiviral treatment
When chronic HBV is causing or threatening liver damage, antiviral therapy may reduce progression risk
Long-term monitoring for liver injury and complications is essential
treatment_principles_zh: 急性 B 肝多以支持性治療為主，重症則需專科處理
並非每位慢性 B 肝患者都需要抗病毒治療
慢性 HBV 已造成或可能造成肝損傷時，抗病毒治療可降低疾病進展風險
需長期監測肝損傷與併發症
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。病毒感染本身不是中醫證型；若有黃疸、脅痛、納差、乏力等，可依實際舌脈與病程鑑別濕熱、肝鬱脾虛、瘀阻或正虛等候選機轉。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. HBV infection itself is not a TCM pattern. If jaundice, hypochondriac discomfort, poor appetite, or fatigue are present, candidate mechanisms can be generated from the actual findings rather than from the viral diagnosis alone.

conditions.overview_en: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is persistent kidney structural damage or reduced kidney function that impairs filtration and can progress to kidney failure and systemic complications.
conditions.overview_zh: 慢性腎臟病（CKD）是持續的腎臟結構損傷或腎功能下降，使血液過濾能力受損，並可能進展為腎衰竭及全身性併發症。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Progressive nephron injury and maladaptive hyperfiltration reduce filtration capacity. Diabetes and hypertension are leading causes in adults, while CKD itself increases cardiovascular, hematologic, mineral-bone, and metabolic risk.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 腎元持續受損與代償性過度過濾會逐步降低腎臟過濾能力。成人常見病因為糖尿病與高血壓，而 CKD 本身也增加心血管、血液、礦物質骨代謝與其他全身風險。
diagnostic_signs_en: Early CKD is often asymptomatic
Later findings may include edema, fatigue, pruritus, appetite changes, hypertension, or uremic symptoms
Risk is higher with diabetes, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, or family history of kidney failure
diagnostic_signs_zh: 早期 CKD 常無症狀
後期可出現水腫、疲倦、搔癢、食慾變化、高血壓或尿毒症症狀
糖尿病、高血壓、心血管疾病或腎衰竭家族史會提高風險
diagnostic_tests_en: Serum creatinine with estimated GFR
Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio and urinalysis
Confirm chronicity over time rather than relying on a single abnormal value
Additional blood tests, imaging, and etiologic workup according to presentation
diagnostic_tests_zh: 血清 creatinine 與估算 eGFR
尿白蛋白／肌酸酐比值與尿液分析
需用時間證明慢性持續性，不能只依單次異常值
依臨床表現安排其他血液、影像與病因檢查
treatment_principles_en: Identify and treat the cause and monitor eGFR and albuminuria trends
Control blood pressure and diabetes when present
Use kidney-protective pharmacotherapy when indicated and review nephrotoxic or renally cleared medications
Manage cardiovascular risk and CKD complications; refer to nephrology when appropriate
treatment_principles_zh: 找出並處理病因，追蹤 eGFR 與白蛋白尿趨勢
有高血壓或糖尿病時妥善控制
有適應症時使用腎臟保護性藥物，並審查腎毒性或需依腎功能調整的藥物
管理心血管風險與 CKD 併發症，適當時轉介腎臟專科
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。CKD 不是「腎虛」的同義詞。水腫、乏力、納差、腰膝痠軟、尿量改變等需依病程鑑別脾腎虛損、濕濁、水濕、瘀血等複合候選機轉。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. CKD is not synonymous with 'Kidney deficiency.' Edema, fatigue, poor appetite, low-back/knee weakness, and urinary change can generate mixed candidate mechanisms involving Spleen-Kidney deficiency, damp/turbidity, fluid retention, or blood stasis.

conditions.overview_en: Nephrolithiasis is formation of solid mineral-containing stones within the urinary tract. Small stones may pass spontaneously, while obstructing stones can cause severe pain, bleeding, infection, or urinary obstruction.
conditions.overview_zh: 腎結石是泌尿道內形成含礦物質的固體結石。小結石可能自行排出，但阻塞性結石可造成劇痛、出血、感染或尿路阻塞。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Urinary supersaturation and crystal formation lead to calcium, uric acid, struvite, or cystine stones. Low urine volume, urinary chemistry, infection, metabolic disorders, diet, and genetic factors can alter stone risk.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 尿液過度飽和與晶體形成可產生鈣結石、尿酸結石、感染性磷酸銨鎂結石或胱胺酸結石。尿量不足、尿液化學環境、感染、代謝疾病、飲食與遺傳因素都會影響風險。
diagnostic_signs_en: Sharp flank, back, lower abdominal, or groin pain
Hematuria
Nausea or vomiting
Fever/chills with obstruction raises concern for infected obstructed urinary tract and requires urgent evaluation
diagnostic_signs_zh: 側腹、背部、下腹或鼠蹊部劇烈疼痛
血尿
噁心或嘔吐
阻塞合併發燒／畏寒需警覺感染性尿路阻塞，須緊急評估
diagnostic_tests_en: Urinalysis and urine studies
Blood tests for renal function and relevant minerals/metabolic abnormalities
Imaging to locate stones and obstruction
Stone analysis and 24-hour urine evaluation in selected recurrent/high-risk patients
diagnostic_tests_zh: 尿液分析與相關尿液檢查
血液檢查腎功能與相關礦物質／代謝異常
影像定位結石並評估阻塞
反覆或高風險患者可考慮結石分析與 24 小時尿液評估
treatment_principles_en: Manage pain, hydration status, and obstruction based on stone size, location, and patient stability
Urgently decompress or otherwise manage infected obstruction or threatened renal function
Use urologic removal or fragmentation when spontaneous passage is unlikely or complications occur
Prevent recurrence according to stone type, urine chemistry, fluid intake, diet, and indicated medications
treatment_principles_zh: 依結石大小、位置與患者穩定度處理疼痛、水分與阻塞
感染性阻塞或腎功能受威脅時需緊急解除阻塞或其他處置
不易自行排出或已有併發症時使用泌尿科取石或碎石治療
依結石種類、尿液化學、水分、飲食與適應症藥物預防復發
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。腎結石與傳統「石淋」可有症狀層面的重疊，但不可視為完全等同；臨床可依疼痛、血尿、排尿困難、口渴、舌脈等再鑑別下焦濕熱、氣滯、瘀阻或正虛等候選機轉。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. Kidney stones can overlap symptomatically with the traditional category of stone strangury, but are not treated as identical entities. Actual urinary, pain, tongue, pulse, and systemic findings should determine candidate mechanisms.

conditions.overview_en: Gout is an inflammatory arthritis caused by deposition of monosodium urate crystals in joints and tissues in the setting of hyperuricemia.
conditions.overview_zh: 痛風是高尿酸血症背景下，單鈉尿酸鹽晶體沉積於關節與組織所造成的發炎性關節炎。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Sustained urate supersaturation permits crystal formation. Crystal deposition activates intense innate inflammatory responses, producing acute flares; persistent deposits may form tophi and cause structural joint damage.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 持續尿酸過度飽和可促成晶體形成；晶體沉積會啟動強烈先天免疫發炎反應造成急性發作，長期沉積可形成痛風石並損傷關節結構。
diagnostic_signs_en: Abrupt severe joint pain, swelling, warmth, and erythema
Often monoarticular during early attacks
Tophi may occur in chronic gout
Consider septic arthritis in an acutely inflamed joint when clinically plausible
diagnostic_signs_zh: 突然出現劇烈關節痛、腫、熱與發紅
早期發作常為單一關節
慢性痛風可形成痛風石
急性紅腫關節若臨床可能，須鑑別感染性關節炎
diagnostic_tests_en: Serum urate can support assessment but does not by itself prove an acute flare
Synovial fluid or tophus aspiration demonstrating urate crystals is highly specific
Ultrasound or dual-energy CT can identify urate deposition in selected cases
diagnostic_tests_zh: 血清尿酸可輔助評估，但單獨不能證明急性發作
關節液或痛風石抽吸找到尿酸鹽晶體具有高度特異性
特定情況可用超音波或雙能量 CT 顯示尿酸鹽沉積
treatment_principles_en: Treat acute inflammation with appropriate anti-inflammatory therapy
For recurrent or clinically significant gout, lower the body urate burden with urate-lowering therapy when indicated
Address modifiable risk factors and relevant kidney/cardiometabolic comorbidities
Use serial urate monitoring and adherence support for long-term control
treatment_principles_zh: 急性期以適當抗發炎治療控制發炎
反覆或具臨床重要性的痛風，有適應症時以降尿酸治療降低體內尿酸負荷
處理可調整的危險因子及腎臟／心代謝共病
長期以尿酸追蹤與用藥遵從支持維持控制
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。急性紅腫熱痛可與濕熱痹阻等候選機轉重疊，慢性反覆期還可能見痰濁、瘀血、脾腎虛等組合；仍須依每次就診的實際表現辨證。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. Hot, swollen acute flares may overlap with damp-heat obstruction, while recurrent/chronic disease may involve phlegm, blood stasis, or Spleen-Kidney deficiency candidates. Visit-level findings must determine the working pattern.

conditions.overview_en: Osteoporosis is a skeletal disease characterized by reduced bone mass and/or deterioration of bone structure, leading to reduced bone strength and increased fracture risk.
conditions.overview_zh: 骨質疏鬆症是骨量下降和／或骨結構惡化的骨骼疾病，使骨強度降低並增加骨折風險。
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_en: Bone remodeling becomes imbalanced so bone resorption exceeds formation, producing lower mineral density and impaired microarchitecture. Aging, menopause, endocrine disease, nutrition, immobility, and medications such as glucocorticoids can contribute.
conditions.biomedical_pathophysiology_zh: 骨重塑失衡，使骨吸收超過骨形成，導致骨密度下降與微結構受損。老化、停經、內分泌疾病、營養、活動不足及糖皮質激素等藥物均可影響風險。
diagnostic_signs_en: Often clinically silent until fracture
Fragility fracture is a major presentation
Height loss, kyphotic posture, or back pain may reflect vertebral compression fractures
Falls and balance impairment increase fracture risk
diagnostic_signs_zh: 常在骨折前沒有明顯症狀
脆弱性骨折是重要臨床表現
身高變矮、後凸姿勢或背痛可能反映椎體壓迫性骨折
跌倒與平衡障礙會增加骨折風險
diagnostic_tests_en: DXA measurement of bone mineral density, usually hip and spine
Clinical fracture history and fracture-risk assessment
Evaluate secondary causes with targeted laboratory testing when appropriate
Imaging for suspected vertebral or other fractures
diagnostic_tests_zh: DXA 測量骨密度，常評估髖部與脊椎
評估既往骨折與整體骨折風險
適當時以針對性檢驗尋找次發原因
懷疑椎體或其他骨折時安排影像
treatment_principles_en: Reduce fracture risk through adequate nutrition, weight-bearing/strength activity when safe, fall prevention, and smoking/alcohol risk reduction
Treat secondary causes when possible
Use osteoporosis medications according to fracture risk and patient factors
Monitor treatment, adherence, and interval fracture risk
treatment_principles_zh: 以足夠營養、安全的負重／肌力活動、跌倒預防及降低菸酒風險減少骨折
可處理的次發原因應一併治療
依骨折風險與個別因素選擇骨質疏鬆藥物
追蹤治療效果、遵從性與後續骨折風險
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_zh: 僅作辨證研究種子。骨質疏鬆不可簡化成「腎虛＝骨質疏鬆」；可依年齡、腰膝痠軟、疲乏、消化狀態、疼痛與舌脈，評估腎精不足、脾腎不足、瘀阻等候選機轉。
conditions.tcm_pathogenesis_en: Differentiation seed only. Osteoporosis must not be reduced to 'Kidney deficiency = osteoporosis.' Age, constitutional findings, digestion, pain, tongue, pulse, and other data should determine candidate mechanisms such as Kidney essence deficiency, Spleen-Kidney deficiency, or stasis.
